granite_rung_with_expectations: # config.expected has no inline CLI form: run_export.sh writes this JSON
# to a file and passes --expected <path>, so a missing file is a hard
# error instead of a silently empty expectation.
# -- code facts: this step's defaults, the same on every cluster --
# A CPU pod's HOME may be read-only or root-owned, and transformers wants
# a cache; the tokenizer is only ever copied, never tokenized with.
